row.text: 🔺 **F-2642-3 — OWNER: the registry deploy day is now ACTIONABLE, and the desk entry's own trigger condition has been met.** `docs/OWNER-DESK-2026-09-19.md:100–101` reads *"Astra is landing the registry code behind a closed gate now (lane-b) … I bring you the checklist when the code lands."* **The code has landed (`fdfcab4d0`) and the checklist is `docs/ops/account-registry.md`** — five steps, each with its verification and its rollback sentence. ⚖️ **NOTHING DEPLOYED AND NOTHING MIGRATED, by construction and not by promise: the Pages binding ships as a COMMENTED block in `wrangler.toml` with `ACCOUNT_REGISTRY_SCOPE` deliberately unset, so both are absent and the door behaves byte-identically to main — which `closed-gate.test.mjs` asserts directly rather than by inspection.** Routine Pages deploys are unaffected. ⛔ **NO FIRE MAY ENABLE THIS**: the five steps need the owner's own deployment inventory, a quiesce of every identity writer including previews, an independently verified private export, a migration secret and a post-bootstrap smoke test of legacy saves — none of which the repo can know or automate. It is on the desk, not on the board.

🧭 **OWNER RULINGS 2026-09-26, THE DESK ANSWERED (verbatim: "A1 - not sure, 2 - sure, lets do that, 3 - ok, lets do that, 4 - a, a, move it to the cradle's rim, its own sculpt pack, a, B5 - deploy, C6 - lets keep it as it is, 7 - slips is good, 8 - unnamed, 9 - sure, do it, D - as you recommend it, E - please cleand the test temp dirs do as you see fit here"):** A1 parked (unsure, no spend); A2 the River's quiet pan writes the completed score; A3 the in-game county board reads the open week; A4 Regatta tie (a), disembark (a) and the Far Side cradle rim and the River raw route's own sculpt pack RE-AFFIRMED (all four had been ruled and LANDED on 2026-09-22; their ledger rows were ghosts, F-ATT-5), the Charter Press hides locked lands (the one fork that was open); B5 `localhost-cors-2` deploys; C the film: no Baron ride (it cuts on the arrival), printed slips, unnamed boards, the three public-site changes; D the ops-evening batch as recommended (F-KV1-7 (a), F-KV2-6 keep, F-KV1-3 default, F-2355-2 on the evening, F-2352-3 ordering, F-2299-1 re-probe); E the temp fixtures cleaned, the veto windows closed as the attended session saw fit (F-CW2-1 stands, F-RT40-1 stands, F-SGA1-2 accepted, F-CW1-2/F-CW2-4 art deferred, F-F2-39 as recommended, F-2350-3 allowlist widening deferred: the guard reddens). Every slice authored from these quotes the owner's words with this date.

🧹 **F-STO-1 (attended 2026-10-25; the owner: "Can you help clean up the storage needed by Gold Rush … I think Gold Rush uses 600 GB") — THE DISK HELD 1,312 GB OF GOLD RUSH, 86 GB FREE OF 3.6 TB; EVERY SCRATCH WORKTREE CARRIES THE 9–11 GB TRACKED `artifacts/` TREE, SO CHECKOUTS WERE THE MULTIPLIER. Group A (regenerable scratch, no history) removed on the owner's "clean A": 30 merged sibling worktrees `~/Claude/Projects/wt-*` (~300 GB), 21 fire/attended arena checkouts under `~/.goldrush/` (their logs kept), the `land/wt-preview-pub` rsync staging copy (86 GB), four re-land clones in `~/.goldrush/repair` whose tips equal the `candidate/*` branches on GitHub (53 GB; commit maps kept), two old gate worktrees in the primary, eight orphan lane copies inside the history clone whose `.git` files pointed at the primary's live lanes (their 94 untracked unique files, 354 MB of July marketing reels and raw media, archived first to `~/.goldrush/archive/history-local-worktrees-untracked-2026-10-25/`), the stray `Gold%20Rush` folder. Every removal through `git worktree remove` after a merged-branch check and an evidence-only dirt check; 14 items the checks held back were examined by hand (stale checkouts: files equal to blobs of 2026-09-20 / 2026-07-05 commits; a gate worktree whose edits equal main's; control arenas differing only in the pilots symlink) and removed in a second pass. Result: free 86 GB → 782 GB. KEPT AS HISTORY: the history clone's `.git` (106 GB, the only full copy of the private history archive: 443 of its 613 refs are not on GitHub), the film's 23 takes (24 GB), `GoldRush-assets` (13 GB), the primary's `artifacts/`, `logs/`, `tasks/runs` (17 GB), `gr-worktree-evidence`, the run logs. OPEN FOR THE OWNER: `gr-gauntlet` (290 GB: four rider arenas with 19 GB duplicate `.git` copies, ~9 GB dependencies, ~100 GB tracked checkouts, ~40 GB heat evidence to keep), `goldrush-gauntlet` carries 22 unpushed commits (agent memories of heats 11–12), an external drive for the ~200 GB of history, and the structural cure (sparse checkouts without `artifacts/` for scratch worktrees). Log: `~/.goldrush/maintenance/cleanup-2026-10-25.log`.
